description: React component for a suggestion box in Mattermost, handling suggestion rendering, keyboard navigation, and user interactions.

classes.name: SuggestionBox
classes.description: React component managing suggestion list display, user input, and keyboard interactions.

methods.name: preventSuggestionListClose
methods.description: Prevents suggestion list from closing temporarily.

methods.name: handleFocusOut
methods.description: Handles input losing focus, clears suggestions if appropriate.

methods.name: handleFocusIn
methods.description: Handles input gaining focus, optionally opens suggestions.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles input value change, updates pretext.

methods.name: handleCompositionStart
methods.description: Marks start of composition (e.g., CJK input).

methods.name: addTextAtCaret
methods.description: Inserts a suggestion term at the cursor position.

methods.name: replaceText
methods.description: Replaces input value with a selected term.

methods.name: handleCompleteWord
methods.description: Completes the current word suggestion, handles special commands.

methods.name: setSelection
methods.description: Sets the current selection to a specific term.

methods.name: makeHandleReceivedSuggestionsAndComplete
methods.description: Creates a callback to handle suggestions and auto-complete first suggestion.

methods.name: nonDebouncedPretextChanged
methods.description: Handles pretext change without debounce, updates suggestions.

methods.name: setContainerRef
methods.description: Sets container ref and manages event listeners.

methods.name: getListPosition
methods.description: Determines list position based on alignment.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the suggestion box component with input and suggestion list.
